page: Amazon Web Services x2iedn.24xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64, supporting Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI) and hardware-accelerated cryptography via AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. It is equipped with 3072.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 32.0 GB of RAM per physical core.

The instance includes 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 75 Gbps. Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 92868.95 and a Passmark CPU score of 74908.92. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 5008.9 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 296.57 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Single-core performance is moderate, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1891.98.

Given its massive memory capacity and local NVMe storage, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, and enterprise applications. It demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations, achieving 29638.46 on Passmark database benchmarks and 88.2 million operations per second in Redis SET operations. The high resource density of memory relative to compute cores offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require massive RAM footprints without needing proportional scaling of CPU licenses.
